nominal_atmosphere.note: The experimental table carries no O2 or pressure. Read in full for a chamber or cabin atmosphere: the ISA-Tab study record, the Final Science Report (03 18 10), SAME_Operations Manual_007, SAME EIRD Rev 2.00 and the SAME Baseline Concept Description Document: none states one. The pressures found are not test atmospheres: hardware fill pressures such as 13.2 psia in the Operations Manual, and a requirement for the EIRD ambient-pressure measurement range of 0.08 to 0.13 mPa (a typo for MPa), an instrument range. Not searched: the PowerPoint presentations, the ICES papers, the VPRED, the drawings and the wire-test report. Do not assume cabin air.
